milestones.title: Plan learning and discover YouTube courses
milestones.why: Bring course discovery and day-to-day learning planning into the same library without losing saved progress.
changes: Add status and sprint boards, tasks, course checklists, and ordered roadmaps.
Persist workspace state with revision-aware profile saves and include it in exports.
Search YouTube by keyword with All, Videos, Playlists, and course-focused filters.
Create courses from search results, preserve existing progress, and handle retries and stale searches.
Add search parser regression tests, Docker packaging, and a dedicated usage and API guide.
Preserve the existing browser download-UI removal while retaining authenticated backend download endpoints.
Integrate dev's existing JSON profile import and preserve workspace data on restore, with in-memory database regression tests.

milestones.title: Publish a traceable release timeline
milestones.why: Make the feature history, affected files, commit membership, and outstanding release work visible in one newest-first record.
changes: Provide a standalone HTML timeline with search and stage filters.
Generate commit dates and branch containment from Git rather than treating a merge as proof of deployment.
Keep feature rationale and dated bug or pending-work observations alongside the generated history.

milestones.title: Bookmark courses and filter the library
milestones.why: Keep priority courses easy to find and exclude local SSH material from source control and Docker context.
changes: Add course pinning and a bookmarked-only library filter.
Ignore the local .ssh directory in Git and Docker builds.

milestones.title: Separate development and production deployments
milestones.why: Promote changes through dev before main while keeping deployment environments and their stored data separate.
changes: Add development and production Compose definitions and deployment workflows.
Guard main-branch pull requests so only dev can promote changes.
Update the Tailscale action and add a connectivity check.

milestones.title: Restore a profile from a JSON export
milestones.why: Make exported learning data restorable without replacing account identity or credentials.
changes: Add validated profile import with confirmation and revision conflict protection.
Restore courses, progress, preferences, and activity history from a supported export.

milestones.title: Package FocusTube for local Docker use
milestones.why: Provide a repeatable local runtime with persistent SQLite storage and loopback-only access.
changes: Introduce a Docker image and Compose setup, then simplify them for local use.
Publish the app on localhost:3002 and persist data in a named volume.

milestones.title: Document setup, architecture, and operations
milestones.why: Make the application installable and maintainable with documented workflows, requirements, and limitations.
changes: Add the project README with setup, API, security, and troubleshooting guidance.
Add screenshots of the library, player, dashboard, and profile workflows.

milestones.title: Build the FocusTube learning application
milestones.why: Turn public YouTube playlists and videos into focused courses with durable, per-user learning progress.
changes: Introduce the Node/Express and SQLite application with an authenticated browser interface.
Provide course import, focused playback, completion tracking, analytics, certificates, and optional downloads.

observations.title: Review the existing download-UI removal
observations.why: The working tree already removed browser download controls when this PR was prepared; the original reason was not recorded in this session.
changes: Preserve the submitted UI removal rather than reverting user changes.
Keep the authenticated backend download API and document the API-only state; confirm product intent during review.

observations.title: Refresh the local Docker image
observations.why: Source edits are not mounted into the existing application container.
changes: Verified localhost:3002 serves an older image: youtube-search.js is absent, search filters are absent, and /api/search returns 404.
Rebuild with the existing Compose configuration and verify the resulting image; no container was rebuilt during that check.

observations.title: Review and verify dev-to-prod promotion
observations.why: A commit on a branch is not evidence that a deployment completed or that a running environment has that revision.
changes: Review the new feature PR into dev, then use a separate dev-to-main PR for production promotion.
Check deployment workflow results and the running application's revision before declaring either environment deployed.

observations.title: Review the existing Docker base-image findings
observations.why: The editor's image scan reported vulnerabilities in the unchanged alpine:3.24.1 base image.
changes: The observed report contained 2 critical and 7 high findings; this is a dated observation, not a fresh scan or a claim of application exploitability.
Re-scan the current image, assess findings, and test a base-image update separately.
